Command line entry point

Source: R/render_file.R
manim_cli.Rd

Mirrors manim render for use with Rscript: Rscript -e 'manimR::manim_cli()' scenes.R SceneName -ql -p. FILE is an R script (or a .cfg file whose input_file names the script), followed by scene names; with no scene names a script with one scene renders it and a script with several asks which to render (-a renders all).

Usage

manim_cli(args = commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE))

Arguments

args

Character vector of arguments; defaults to the trailing command line arguments.

Value

The result of the subcommand, invisibly.

Details

It takes upstream's options: -c/--config_file, --disable_caching, --tex_template, -v/--verbosity, --notify_outdated_version and --silent, --enable_gui, --gui_location, --fullscreen, --enable_wireframe, --dry_run, --no_latex_cleanup, --preview_command, --seed, -o/--output_file, -0/--zero_pad, --media_dir, --log_dir, --log_to_file, -n N[,M] (render animations N through M, counted from 0), -a/--write_all, --format, -s/--save_last_frame, -q/--quality (also -ql, -qm, -qh, -qp, -qk), -r/--resolution W,H, --fps/--frame_rate, --video-codec, --pixel-format, --encoder-option KEY=VALUE (repeatable), --max-inflight-encoders, --encoder-queue-size, --renderer, --save_sections, -t/--transparent, --use_projection_fill_shaders, --use_projection_stroke_shaders, --progress_bar, -p/--preview, -l/--live-preview, --show_in_file_browser, plus manimR's --flush_cache. Short flags can be combined (-pql). A manim.cfg in the working directory is read first unless -c names another file, and the command line wins over both. The OpenGL window options are accepted; asking for a live preview is an error, as with upstream's Cairo renderer. Options can also be written --name=value, and render may come first, as in manim render.

The other subcommands of manim:

  • checkhealth reports the programs manimR uses (manim_check()).

  • cfg show prints the settings, cfg write writes them to manim.cfg in the working directory and cfg export --dir DIR into DIR.

  • init project NAME creates a project folder with main.R and a manim.cfg (upstream's default settings: 1920 x 1080 at 30 fps); init scene NAME [FILE] appends a scene template to FILE (main.R).

  • plugins -l lists installed plugins (list_plugins()).

  • cache clear FILE SCENE ... deletes the partial movie files of those scenes, for the quality given with -q and the media directory given with --media-dir.

  • --version prints the version.
